displayName: 诺克提斯·路西斯·凯拉姆 Noctis Lucis Caelum
description: Unofficial Noctis Lucis Caelum fan-art companion from Final Fantasy XV. Original animation includes seated toy fishing, photo-card inspection, drowsy jacket adjustment and playful toy-food choices. The rod has a short soft string and no hook; food is a model. Lower travel-clothing detail is simplified from familiar cues.
